{{Top}}
'''Landing barges''' were [[Starship/Legends|starships]] designed to transport large amounts of ground vehicles and [[Soldier/Legends|troops]] to a planetary surface. During the [[Third Battle of Vontor]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] used immense landing barges to shuttle his troops to the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vontor]] to battle the forces of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[General/Legends|general]] [[Kossak Inijic Ar'durv]].
